dialogues.speaker: Reetta
dialogues.text: Something noteworthy... Well, when Miss Ehrnrooth and Miss Vernadska were bringing me around on patrol, I saw some shiny things in the area...

dialogues.speaker: Reetta
dialogues.text: Miss Ehrnrooth said they were called Magical Crystal Ores, and that they made good forging materials... I don't get it, all I know is that they look really pretty. If I'm not wrong, they should be around... here.
